name: Nature Recovery Fund
summary: Unrestricted, multi-year funding plus mentoring and skilled-volunteer support for small UK charities and social enterprises restoring, expanding and connecting habitats, working with landowners and communities, or widening participation in conservation. Applicants register in a short window and go through The Fore's staged selection.

amount.note: Unrestricted funding over one to three years

steps: Full application, if confirmed a place
Online ideas-testing meeting, if long listed

eligibility.rule: Is a registered charity, CIC limited by guarantee, or charitable or asset-locked CBS
Has its UK registration approved, not still in process
Has no active grant, or has closed it and had a grant closure call

calls.label: Spring 2027 funding round

status.quote: we've designed our inaugural Nature Recovery Fund and are very proud to be launching it as part of our Spring 2027 Funding Round

calls.note: Short registration window, then full applications from registered charities; dates on the page have no year

applicant_types.quote: Our grants programme is open to: Registered Charities (including those constituted as charitable trusts, charitable unincorporated associations, charitable incorporated organisations and charitable companies limited by guarantee), Community Interest Companies (CICs) limited by guarantee

geography.quote: Applicants in any location or sector, but you need to be registered in the UK

access.quote: we are encouraging applications from high-potential, ambitious organisations tackling these important problems

window.quote: Registrations for the round open from 12pm (midday) on Wednesday 25th November to 12pm (midday) on Friday 4th December.

amount.quote: With our wraparound support package of up to £45,000 of unrestricted funding

effort.quote: The first step to applying is to register your interest.
You have around three weeks to complete your application
Long listed applicants are invited via email for an "ideas testing" meeting with one of our "Strategic Applicant Consultants
Stage 3: Shortlisted applications are taken to our funding panels

eligibility.quote: Registered Charities (including those constituted as charitable trusts, charitable unincorporated associations, charitable incorporated organisations and charitable companies limited by guarantee), Community Interest Companies (CICs) limited by guarantee, or Community Benefit Societies (CBSs) that are either Charitable CBSs or non-charitable CBSs with an asset lock
Your annual revenue should be less than £500k

We are unable to fund organisations whose registration (as a charity, community interest company limited by guarantee, charitable incorporated organisation or community benefit society in the UK) is in process but has not yet been approved.
If you have an active grant, you can't reapply until your existing grant has closed and you've had a "grant closure" call with our team
